evidenceContract.userBehavior: Request one complete time-based production-design specification from an actual screenplay while explicitly excluding model calls and execution.

observables.description: Exact Skill receipt, screenplay evidence, one production specification with creative, continuity, unit and finishing contracts, and absent generation side effects.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: The Agent returns one concise master specification containing a creative contract, only recurring character/scene continuity, one authoritative shot table whose rows own story function, image/action, camera/sound, input requirements, production method and direct acceptance, and one cross-shot finishing/delivery contract. It does not write source-analysis narration, per-stage documents, runtime status, call packets, or generic workflow steps.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: Stopping at a concept paragraph and beat list, omitting character/scene continuity or finishing design, duplicating decisions across sections, splitting the result into analysis/preparation/generation/post documents, inventing Tool calls, or executing production fails.

steps.prompt: $media-production 读取 @screenplay.fountain。为这支 60 秒动画 PV 设计一份完整但简洁的制作规格，必须是一份主文档，包含创作合同、必要的人物与场景连续性、权威镜头表以及后期与交付合同。镜头表需要同时承载剧情作用、画面动作、摄影声音、输入需求、生产方式和直接验收。不要写来源分析过程，不要拆成多份阶段文档，不要准备模型调用或执行生成。
